summary: Implementation fully matches the saved plan across all three issues. #404: _reconcile_fallback_edits_into_upper takes a required host_claude kwarg (passed source_dir in _prepare_isolated_claude_auth) and _legacy_is_unedited_host_copy refuses to overwrite an existing upper REGULAR file with a strictly-newer legacy copy that is byte/mtime-identical to the live host, while a divergent (agent-edited) legacy file is still forwarded. #402: a second pass _forward_fallback_deletions_as_whiteouts diffs base vs legacy and synthesizes overlayfs whiteouts only on confident agent deletions (upper has no entry, host still matches base byte/mtime, CAP_MKNOD present); host-lacks-path, host-changed, and missing-CAP_MKNOD all fail safe and never whiteout. New _safe_overlay_whiteout (symlink-safe O_NOFOLLOW descent, mknod char 0,0, OSError-fail-safe returning False), _has_cap_mknod / _CAP_MKNOD_BIT=27 (shared _capeff_has_bit parser), _safe_stat, and CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_WHITEOUT_INCAPABLE reason code. #405: base-pin write stays keep-live/non-fatal; the keep-live regression is extended to assert a second-provision re-pin, and test_overlay_reboot_without_pin_rebuilds_and_repins locks in remount + durable re-pin with no upper loss. Scope is correct: only auth_mounts.py, auth_mounts_claude.py, auth_mounts_overlay_copy.py and their test parts changed; bootstrap.py/cleanup.py/pre_push_validation.py untouched. All new names re-exported through auth_mounts.py and every planned test is present. The new reason code mirrors sibling _CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_* event codes that are absent from the generated REASON_CATALOG.md, so no catalog regen is required (consistent with the siblings). Partial validation evidence exists (.pytest_cache lastfailed is empty and .coverage measured exactly the three changed modules at 02:23), but the AWF-owned lint/type/full-coverage gates have no recorded green evidence, so satisfied cannot be confirmed.
